title: Sean Payton: No hurry with Taysom Hill, I'll see him in Canton this week

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Sean Payton: No hurry with Taysom Hill, I'll see him in Canton this week
sources.description: Broncos head coach Sean Payton will be in Canton, Ohio this week to take part in Drew Brees's induction into the Pro Football Hall of Fame and he'll also do a little work on a possible addition to his roster.
